title: Cross-slot fresh written research releases
problem: Every slot primary is stopped or blocked by episode-specific method/source findings, and owners report parked intervals of 35m–1h17m that are parent allocation latency. Several stops name their own reopening condition: an independently source/method-separated, explicitly admitted method. The original owner cannot certify separation from their own private held episode.
decision: Main may freeze a narrow cross-slot written-research release assigning one precisely stated open sub-question of slot X to a DIFFERENT existing owner Y. Y never had access to X-owner private held episodes (they were never serialized); Main supplies only literal definitions, Main parent dispositions and already adopted pre-event author sources. This is the independently admitted method contemplated by those stops, not a cleansing of the original owner, helper substitution for a contaminated release, or a restart of the original owner's primary.

excluded_lines: physics-2 (parent L1 quarantine forbids helper substitution/salvage)
info-1 privacy, info-5 R-minus, physics-5 RQLS, physics-6 AME (Main itself has source-boundary exposure on these lines, so a Main-written release could carry it)
math-5 Shor for now (held continuation topics overlap natural completion-counting methods; deferred out of caution)
eligibility.selection_basis: Sub-questions are taken ONLY from the exact NR/open statements in adopted pre-event texts and parent dispositions, never from the content or topic of a held episode, which Main has never seen.

rules: Researcher reads S0, this program record and its own frozen release FIRST, then writes an actual-clock prebody ACK in its OWN root disclosing all prior exposure to the target slot (reviews, status records, any contact with the target author) before opening any packet input.

Inputs ONLY the frozen release inputs plus ordinary elementary facts proved in writing; named classical theorems only at stated level with exact statement/use/consequence-if-false, marked NR-IMPORT if not proved.
No source/web/book/paper access, no target-author contact, no held/withdrawn/ZERO body or consumer, no legacy checkpoint mining.

No scientific interpreter/calculator/CAS/program/enumeration/solver/replay/test/typechecker and no selected numeric/group/state/word/parameter sanity probe, even privately. If one occurs: stop, report safely, quarantine.
If the intended method is recognized as guided by an excluded episode, stop that branch and report.

Write ONLY new additive files in the researcher's own root. First substantive result or exact obstruction within 20 min of ACK; bounded cycles thereafter; honest gaps. Results are author candidates of the TARGET problem with cross-slot provenance; they require frozen disjoint review and complete Main reads before adoption.
non_effects: No original STOP is lifted for the original owner; no clean-cognition, novelty, formal/kernel, executable, human or independent-model claim; N4 UNKNOWN historical child exit unestablished, auxiliary214 STOP, HOLDv2 and global parent source pause persist.
parked_interval_accounting: Owners without an admissible duty are parked; Main records those intervals parent-side as allocation latency. Owners need not file repeated gap records while parked.
